title: The tags don't stay tied inside
text: The tags don't stay tied inside. While this blanket is good for my son's sleep, it is not made well. Maybe I got a dud, but the ties don't stay tied, so the inside slides around inside the cover. The ties are grosgrain ribbons which do not hold well. Also the ties are at the corners and sides, but the inside part only has tabs to tie to at the corners. So the cover doesn't work with the insides as advertised. Take a risk getting this item.
